SERVICE AGREEMENT — VERSION B (REVISED)

This Service Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of March 1, 2024, between:

TechCorp Solutions LLC ("Service Provider"), a Delaware limited liability company, and Retail Dynamics Inc. ("Client"), a New York corporation.

1. SERVICES

Service Provider agrees to provide software development and consulting services as described in Statement of Work No. 1, attached hereto and incorporated by reference.

Service Provider may subcontract portions of the work to qualified third parties, provided that Service Provider remains responsible for the delivery of all Services. [CHANGED from V1: subcontracting now permitted]

2. PAYMENT TERMS

Client shall pay Service Provider a monthly retainer of $12,000 per month, payable within fifteen (15) days of the first day of each month. [CHANGED from V1: was $8,000; payment window changed from 30 days to 15 days]

Late payments shall accrue interest at a rate of 2.5% per month. [CHANGED from V1: was 1.5% per month]

3. TERM AND TERMINATION

This Agreement commences on March 1, 2024 and continues for a period of two (2) years unless earlier terminated.

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days prior written notice. [CHANGED from V1: was 30 days notice]

Either party may terminate immediately for cause upon written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to cure such breach within fifteen (15) days of receiving written notice thereof.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

All work product, inventions, software, designs, and deliverables created by Service Provider in the performance of Services under this Agreement shall be the exclusive property of Client upon full payment. [CHANGED from V1: IP now assigned on full payment rather than on creation]

Service Provider retains a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use generalized methodologies and know-how developed during the engagement.

5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Neither party shall be liable to the other for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages.

The total liability of either party under this Agreement shall not exceed three (3) times the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. [CHANGED from V1: cap was one (1) times fees]

6. INDEMNIFICATION

Each party shall indemnify and hold harmless the other party from claims arising from its own gross negligence or willful misconduct. [UNCHANGED]

7. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York. [CHANGED from V1: was Delaware]

8. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement, together with all Statements of Work, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, or agreements.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first set forth above.
